QuestInfo.name: Dreadful Hero
QuestInfo.1: Find the hero who eliminated Zakum. #bMake a party with a player who has a Zakum Helmet or Chaos Zakum Helmet equipped#k.\r\n\r\n#r<<To clear this mission you must make a party with a player on the same screen as you.>>#k

yes.0: Today's mission is to locate a player who eliminated Zakum. Find and #bjoin a party with a player who has a Zakum Helmet or Chaos Zakum Helmet equipped#k, and I will mark the mission as complete.

1.0: You did it! Good work. Here's your gift.
